title: Cover letter fit and consistency
summary: A fit and consistency result: ready or revise. Checks that the letter answers two to four of the top requirements with specific examples and gives a sourced reason for this employer, that every fact matches the resume and master history, that it adds to the resume rather than restating it, and its form: one page, correct company, role and addressee. The candidate approves before sending.
notes: Facts about the employer must come from linked sources (the posting, the employer's site); anything else is marked unverified.
Link the tailored resume and its requirement map from the resume workflow to reuse them.
The voice check runs only when a writing sample is linked.

inputs.label: The job description
inputs.help: Link the posting for the role this letter applies to.

inputs.label: The tailored resume
inputs.help: Link the tailored resume (and the master history if you have it) so facts can be checked.

config.instructions: List the posting's most important requirements, most stressed first (no more than eight).

config.question: Does the letter answer this requirement with a specific example (situation, action, result)? Quote it.

config.instructions: List each factual claim the letter makes about the candidate (employer, title, date, number, skill, achievement) and about the employer.

statuses.label: Absent from the resume and master history
Employer fact with no linked source

config.question: For a claim about the candidate: does it match the resume and master history (employers, titles, dates, numbers, skills)? For a claim about the employer: does a linked source (posting, employer site) support it?

categories.label: Adds context
categories.description: Gives context, motivation or a story the resume cannot carry

categories.label: Restates the resume
categories.description: Repeats resume lines and adds nothing
categories.suggestion: Replace with the context behind the result, or cut.

categories.label: Generic
categories.description: Could be sent to any employer unchanged
categories.suggestion: Tie it to this employer using a linked source.

config.instructions: Compare each paragraph with the linked resume.

checklist.label: Correct company and role
checklist.question: Do the company name and role match the posting everywhere in the letter?

checklist.label: Correct addressee
checklist.question: Is the addressee the person or team the posting or sources name, or a neutral greeting?

checklist.label: No leftover names
checklist.question: Is the letter free of any company, person or role from another application?

checklist.label: Sourced reason for this employer
checklist.question: Does the letter give a specific reason for this employer drawn from a linked source?

checklist.label: Two to four requirements answered
checklist.question: Does the letter answer two to four of the top requirements with specific examples?

checklist.label: Matches the writing sample
checklist.question: If a writing sample is linked, which passages depart from the candidate's voice? Answer not_applicable when there is no sample.

config.instructions: Approve the letter before sending. Check the company, role and addressee once more yourself.
